game.name: Winter Sports 2011 : Go for Gold (Europe)
game.desc: Winter Sports 2011 on Xbox 360 is a compilation of winter games with 9 disciplines (Bobsleigh, Biathlon, Alpine Skiing, Snowboarding, Snowmobile...) and a total of 14 environments. It is possible to play up to 4 players, both online and in split screen.
